scripts.webpack: npm run remove-module-type && npm run development
scripts.set-module-type: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const packageJson = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf-8')); packageJson.type = 'module'; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(packageJson, null, 2));"
scripts.remove-module-type: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const packageJson = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf-8')); delete packageJson.type; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(packageJson, null, 2));"
